headline: 5 Bangladeshis killed in Qatar road crash
summary: The victims were expatriates from Sylhet, Bangladesh, among a total of six people killed in the accident.
details: Five Bangladeshi expatriates have been killed in a road accident in Qatar.
The victims were all from the Sylhet region of Bangladesh.
A total of six people died in the crash, with five of them being Bangladeshi nationals.
The incident has caused widespread grief in the hometowns of the victims.

headline_marked: Sylhet [[DC Sarwoer Alam withdrawn]] from post
headline: Sylhet DC Sarwoer Alam withdrawn from post
summary: The Deputy Commissioner and District Magistrate has been attached to the Ministry of Public Administration without an official reason provided.
details: Sylhet’s Deputy Commissioner and District Magistrate Sarwoer Alam has been withdrawn from his post and attached to the Ministry of Public Administration.
A circular issued by the Ministry of Public Administration today confirmed the move.
The withdrawal comes amid a period where the DC was both praised and criticized for his management of funds for the shrines of Hazrat Shahjalal (R) and Shahporan (R) in Sylhet.
The official circular did not specify a reason for the withdrawal, nor has a replacement for the position been appointed yet.
Sarwoer Alam was appointed as the Sylhet DC on August 18 last year, after previously serving as an executive magistrate in Dhaka.
caption:
